title: Run King! RUN!!!
reviewNotes: All 42 diagrams/captions re-reviewed, including native38–41. Complete eighteen-piece later Qf3/Bg8/Kg3 versus Kg6 root retains both black rooks, bishops and all nine surviving pawns. Qf5+ is proved against Kg7, Kh6 and Kxf5. The native source capture is Kxf5, while the bishop stays on f6 and blocks a king flight; Bh7 mates. Both independent king refusals permit Qh7 mate. Earlier knight sacrifice/king chase/uniqueness claims remain outside proof.
